amused.en: A child laughs at a clown's silly tricks.
amused.zh: 一个孩子被小丑的把戏逗得哈哈大笑。

astonished.en: Friends surprise a child with a small party.
astonished.zh: 朋友们给一个孩子准备了惊喜派对。

breathless.en: After running very fast, a child stops to catch their breath.
breathless.zh: 跑得太快了，一个孩子停下来喘口气。

cheerful.en: Sunlight streams through the window, brightening a child's mood.
cheerful.zh: 阳光照进窗户，孩子的心情也亮起来。

concerned-met.en: A child notices a friend is sad and offers to help.
concerned-met.zh: 一个孩子发现朋友难过，主动关心他。

confident.en: After practicing, a child knows they can do a difficult task.
confident.zh: 练习之后，一个孩子相信自己能完成难事。

elated.en: A child feels thrilled after finishing a beautiful drawing.
elated.zh: 一个孩子画好一幅漂亮的画，高兴极了。

enchanted.en: A child listens closely to a beautiful bedtime story.
enchanted.zh: 孩子听美妙的睡前故事听得入迷。

encouraged.en: A friend cheers for a child who is trying something difficult.
encouraged.zh: 孩子尝试一件难事时，朋友在旁边加油。

engrossed.en: A child reads an exciting book and forgets the time.
engrossed.zh: 孩子读一本有趣的书，专心得忘了时间。

enlivened.en: A lively song plays, and a quiet child starts dancing.
enlivened.zh: 活泼的音乐响起，原本安静的孩子跳起舞来。

exhilarated.en: A child celebrates after winning a close game.
exhilarated.zh: 一场激烈的比赛结束，一个孩子赢了，兴奋地欢呼。

expectant.en: A child counts the days until a holiday trip.
expectant.zh: 孩子数着日子，期待假期旅行快点到来。

fulfilled.en: A child steps back to admire a tall block tower they built.
fulfilled.zh: 孩子搭好高高的积木塔，满意地欣赏着。

glad.en: Someone thanks a child for being helpful.
glad.zh: 有人感谢孩子的帮助，孩子心里很高兴。

grateful.en: A friend helps a child on a difficult day.
grateful.zh: 一个朋友在孩子遇到困难时伸出援手。

gratified.en: A carefully made plan works out just as the children hoped.
gratified.zh: 孩子们认真制订的计划顺利实现了。

inspired.en: A child sees a painting and gets an idea for their own artwork.
inspired.zh: 孩子看到一幅画，突然有了创作的新点子。

intense-met.en: A moving movie leaves a child feeling something very strongly.
intense-met.zh: 一部感人的电影让孩子心里涌起强烈的感受。

intrigued.en: A child cannot wait to find out the ending of a mystery story.
intrigued.zh: 一个孩子读着神秘故事，迫不及待想知道结局。

invigorated.en: A child wakes up refreshed after a good night's sleep.
invigorated.zh: 睡了一个好觉，孩子醒来精神十足。

involved.en: A child joins their friends in making a school project.
involved.zh: 孩子和朋友一起参加班级作品制作。

mellow.en: A child relaxes in the warm light of a quiet afternoon.
mellow.zh: 一个孩子在暖暖的午后阳光里放松下来。

pleasant.en: A gentle breeze cools a child on a warm day.
pleasant.zh: 温暖的日子里，微风吹过孩子的脸颊。

proud.en: A child finishes a difficult project after many attempts.
proud.zh: 孩子试了很多次，终于完成一个很难的作品。

refreshed.en: After sleeping well, a child wakes up ready for a new day.
refreshed.zh: 睡了一个好觉，孩子醒来神清气爽。

satisfied.en: A child finishes a tasty meal and feels comfortably full.
satisfied.zh: 孩子吃完美味的一餐，感觉刚刚好。

sensitive-met.en: A touching movie brings tears to a child's eyes.
sensitive-met.zh: 一部感人的电影让孩子眼眶湿润。

splendid.en: Children look up at a colorful fireworks display.
splendid.zh: 孩子们抬头观看绚丽的烟花表演。

surprised-met.en: A friend gives a child an unexpected gift.
surprised-met.zh: 朋友突然送来一份礼物，孩子又惊又喜。

touched.en: A child feels loved when someone helps them kindly.
touched.zh: 有人温柔地帮助孩子，让孩子感到被爱。

tranquil.en: A child sits quietly beside a smooth lake at sunrise.
tranquil.zh: 日出时，孩子安静地坐在平静的湖边。

trusting.en: A child tells a close friend a secret because they feel safe.
trusting.zh: 一个孩子相信好朋友，放心地说出心里的秘密。

wonderful.en: A family looks back on a wonderful trip together.
wonderful.zh: 一家人回忆着一次美好的旅行。

angry.en: Someone accidentally breaks a child's favorite toy.
angry.zh: 有人不小心弄坏孩子最喜欢的玩具。

apprehensive.en: A child feels nervous about an important test tomorrow.
apprehensive.zh: 想到明天的重要考试，一个孩子有点不安。

beat.en: A child sits down exhausted after a long afternoon of play.
beat.zh: 玩了整整一下午，孩子累得坐下来休息。

bitter.en: A child feels upset after repeatedly being skipped in a game.
bitter.zh: 游戏里总是轮不到自己，孩子心里很不是滋味。

blue.en: A child looks out at the rain and misses playing with friends.
blue.zh: 孩子望着窗外的雨，想念和朋友玩耍的日子。

bored.en: A child has nothing interesting to do on a rainy afternoon.
bored.zh: 下雨的下午，孩子觉得没有什么好玩的事。

brokenhearted.en: A child feels heartbroken after saying goodbye to a dear friend.
brokenhearted.zh: 跟最好的朋友道别后，孩子伤心得不得了。

chagrined.en: A child's carefully planned project does not work out.
chagrined.zh: 孩子认真计划的作品没做成功，心里很懊恼。

concerned-unmet.en: A child worries when a close friend gets sick.
concerned-unmet.zh: 好朋友生病了，一个孩子很担心。

cross.en: Someone keeps interrupting a child who is playing.
cross.zh: 孩子正在玩游戏，却一直被人打断。

dejected.en: A child hangs their head after losing a game.
dejected.zh: 输了游戏，孩子垂着头，心里很失落。

depressed.en: A child has felt very low for a long time and no longer enjoys favorite games.
depressed.zh: 一个孩子持续很久心情低落，连喜欢的游戏也不想玩了。

despondent.en: A child is so downhearted that getting out of bed feels difficult.
despondent.zh: 孩子心里非常低落，连起床都觉得困难。

disaffected.en: A hobby that once felt exciting no longer interests a child.
disaffected.zh: 以前喜欢的爱好，如今让孩子提不起兴趣。

dismayed.en: A carefully made plan suddenly falls apart.
dismayed.zh: 认真做好的计划突然泡汤了，孩子感到震惊又失落。

displeased.en: A child feels disappointed because the movie was not enjoyable.
displeased.zh: 电影并不好看，一个孩子有点不满意。

disturbed.en: Someone interrupts a child in the middle of an important game.
disturbed.zh: 孩子正在专心玩游戏，却突然被人打断。

downhearted.en: After hearing sad news, a child becomes quiet and discouraged.
downhearted.zh: 听到不好的消息后，孩子安静下来，心里难过。

dull.en: A child finds a class boring because nothing new is happening.
dull.zh: 课堂上一直没有新鲜事，孩子觉得很无聊。

exhausted.en: After a long day of playing, a child can barely keep their eyes open.
exhausted.zh: 玩了一整天，孩子累得眼睛都快睁不开了。

forlorn.en: A child sits alone while everyone else has someone to play with.
forlorn.zh: 别人都有玩伴，只有一个孩子孤零零坐在一旁。

furious.en: A child is furious when someone ruins a project they worked hard on.
furious.zh: 辛苦完成的作品被弄坏，孩子非常生气。

helpless.en: A child cannot stop a dear friend from moving away.
helpless.zh: 好朋友要搬走了，孩子觉得自己什么也改变不了。

horrible.en: A frightening nightmare wakes a child up at night.
horrible.zh: 夜里一个可怕的梦把孩子吓醒了。

indifferent.en: A child does not have a preference between two suggested games.
indifferent.zh: 面对两个游戏，孩子觉得选哪个都无所谓。

intense-unmet.en: A child feels a powerful rush of worry before an important event.
intense-unmet.zh: 一件重要的事就要发生，孩子心里涌起强烈的担心。

irked.en: A child grows annoyed when someone keeps interrupting.
irked.zh: 一直被打断，一个孩子越来越烦躁。

jealous.en: A child feels jealous when a friend gets something they wanted.
jealous.zh: 朋友得到了自己想要的东西，孩子心里有点嫉妒。

leery.en: A child hears a strange story and is not sure it is true.
leery.zh: 听到一个奇怪的故事，孩子有点怀疑。

listless.en: A child feels too low on energy to do anything fun.
listless.zh: 孩子没什么精神，连玩都提不起劲。

miserable.en: Many little things go wrong, leaving a child very unhappy.
miserable.zh: 今天好几件小事都不顺利，孩子难受极了。

mopey.en: A child stays quiet and does not feel like playing.
mopey.zh: 一个孩子闷闷不乐地坐着，不想去玩。

nettled.en: A child feels irritated because someone keeps teasing them.
nettled.zh: 有人不停地取笑孩子，孩子心里很烦。

numb.en: After an upsetting moment, a child cannot tell what they are feeling.
numb.zh: 经历难过的事后，孩子一时说不清自己的感受。

passive.en: During a group activity, a child lets everyone else decide.
passive.zh: 小组活动时，一个孩子总是让别人替自己决定。

perplexed.en: A child stares at confusing instructions and does not know where to start.
perplexed.zh: 面对看不懂的说明，孩子不知道从哪一步开始。

puzzled.en: A child cannot figure out how two puzzle pieces fit.
puzzled.zh: 孩子怎么也想不通两块拼图该怎么拼。

repelled.en: A bad smell makes a child quickly step backward.
repelled.zh: 闻到难闻的味道，孩子忍不住往后退。

shocked.en: A sudden loud crash makes a child jump in surprise.
shocked.zh: 突然一声巨响，孩子吃惊得跳了起来。

startled.en: A door slams unexpectedly and startles a child.
startled.zh: 门突然砰地关上，把孩子吓了一跳。

tepid.en: A child answers politely but feels little excitement about an idea.
tepid.zh: 对于一个主意，孩子礼貌回答，但并不太感兴趣。

tired.en: After an active day, a child wants to sit down and rest.
tired.zh: 活动了一整天，孩子想坐下来休息。

unconcerned.en: A child feels unworried about a small problem that seems manageable.
unconcerned.zh: 面对一个容易处理的小问题，孩子并不担心。

weary.en: After a long difficult day, a child wants nothing more than rest.
weary.zh: 辛苦了一整天，孩子只想好好休息。

wretched.en: A child feels deeply unhappy after several things go wrong.
wretched.zh: 好几件事都不顺利，孩子心里非常难受。
